Commentary.Commentary: That ends a bizarre game. New Zealand stay alive with this win but they will be watching the next match with interest. India-Sri Lanka is up next. India have already qualified, but if they win, then it will be knockout for Sri Lanka as well. Join us back at 3 pm local (0400 GMT).

Victorious New Zealand skipper, Sophie Devine, bluntly says that she was shocked with the score at the halfway point. Says that Bangladesh bowled well on a pitch difficult to bat on but then laments the lack of application from her batters. All the more, praises her coach for keeping things calm in the dressing room and making the bowlers believe they could defend this total. Blames her batters for missing straight balls from Bangladesh but adds that her own bowlers took cue from those dismissals. On their next clash against Australia, Devine says that the batting certainly needs to improve. Adds that be it any sport, they are always eager to take on Australia. Aims to take a break on Sunday and then get stuck into the Aussies on Monday.

Bangladesh captain, Salma Khatun, admits that the batting was not good at all. praises Ritu Moni for her excellent bowling. On Bangladesh's final match, Khatun says that they would hope to bat better.

HAYLEY JENSEN HAS BEEN NAMED THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH. Admits that her team did not bat too well but is happy that the bowlers stuck to their task. On the plans, Jensen says that it was just keeping it nice and simple and bowl wicket to wicket. On their quarter-final clash against Australia, Hayley says that Australia are a good unit and they just need to stick to their basics.

Unfair treatment given to the Bangladesh bowlers. They bowled their hearts out, restricting New Zealand to 91 but their batters let them down completely. Tough pill to swallow. Please stay tuned for the presentation...

Definitely a massive opportunity missed by Bangladesh. Yes, they were playing New Zealand for the first time in Women's T20Is, but you do back yourself to chase down 92, don't you? They never got going and then unfortunately had a freak injury to Nigar Sultana. That derailed their chase completely. Just 3 batters managed double figures.

Having chosen to bat first, New Zealand would have aimed for somewhere around 150 but that never came. They lost their way with the bat but with the ball, they came all guns firing. They were miserly in the Powerplay, stifling the runs and then got the wickets eventually. Amelia Kerr started the choke, conceding just 10 in her 4 overs while Hayley Jensen  picked up 3 wickets. Every bowler was economical.

Hmmmm! Which part of the game was more shocking? New Zealand getting bowled out for 91? Or Bangladesh failing to chase down 92? Difficult choice. The White Ferns have found a way to stay alive in this tournament, through some sensational bowling.
OUT! CAUGHT! That is the game now. Full and outside off, Sultana comes down the track and lofts it over mid off. But Sophie Devine at long off takes it comfortably. NEW ZEALAND WIN BY 17 RUNS!
Full and outside off, Ghosh comes down the track and hits it towards long off for a run.
Full and outside off, swept straight to fine leg. Just a single. That should be it. 19 needed from 3 balls.
FOUR! Up and over! Full and outside off, Nigar lofts it over mid off and clears the fielder inside the ring.
Full on middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Sultana swings it over mid-wicket and gets a boundary.
Full and outside off, Sultana looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto her pads.
Outside off, punched through point for a run.
Landed outside off, played uppishly towards point but the ball lands short of point.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
A yorker, around off, nearly sneaks through but Ghosh manages to dig it out.
Sophie Devine comes back on. 3-0-9-1 so far.
Pushes this through mid on for one more.
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a run.

NOT OUT. There is glove involved. Full and outside off, Sultana looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a massive shout for LBW but it is turned down. Kasperek wants a review and her skipper consents. However, Ultra Edge detects a spike when the ball passes the glove.

Is that the end of the game? Nigar Sultana has not been adjudged out on an LBW appeal. Kasperek is confident she has her victim. The review is taken. But Ultra Edge detects a spike when the ball goes past the glove.
Full and down the leg side, worked through fine leg for a single.
Panna Ghosh is the last batter.

OUT! BOWLED! Attempt to innovate does not quite come off. Full and outside off, Salma looks to play the reverse sweep but she does not even get in line of the ball. It skids through, goes beneath the bat and hits the timber.
Full and down the leg side, swept towards fine leg for a single.
Leigh Kasperek returns. 2-0-12-1 so far.
Around middle, Salma pushes this down the track and sets off for a run but is rightly sent back. The bowler quickly got to the ball.
Works this through mid-wicket for one.
Brave call from Nigar Sultana. She has decided to walk out again. But is it too late?
OUT! BOWLED! A wild swing and gone. A length ball, outside off, Fahima comes down the track and swings hard but misses. The ball goes beneath the bat, jags back in and hits the off stump.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.

How did the bat come down? The wrong 'un, outside off, Salma initially looks to let it go but at the last moment, she gets her bat down to avoid getting bowled. The ball runs off the bottom edge towards third man. A single taken.
Full and outside off, slogged through the leg side for a run.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed outside off, another googly, left alone.
Salma Khatun walks out now.
OUT! BOWLED! Amazing delivery. The googly, outside off, Alam looks to defend but the ball spins in, goes between bat and pad and hits the timber. She simply did not pick the wrong 'un.
Amelia Kerr is back on too. 3-0-7-0 so far.
Jahanara Alam walks in at number 9, replacing Mostary.
OUT! CAUGHT! Another wicket. A short ball, outside of, Mostary swings hard, aiming to pull but gets a top edge.  A simple catch for Suzie Bates.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Excellent yorker, around middle, but nicely dug out.
Outside off, on a length, Fahima swings hard but misses.
Full and outside off, Mostary swings hard but gets a thick inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls to the off side and a quick single is taken. A laboured 50 comes up for Bangladesh.
Full on middle, hit over the bowler but straight to mid on. Bounced well short though.
Sophie Devine returns. 2-0-7-0 so far.
Full and outside off, slogged nicely but straight to deep square leg for a run.
Full and outside off, Mostary looks to sweep but misses and is hit on he pads. There is an LBW appeal but the impact is outside off.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.

Another mix-up! Safe this time. Mostary looks to paddle but gets a bottom edge towards short mid-wicket. She sets off for a single but is sent back. Just in time. She returns just before the bails go off.
FOUR! THWACK! A boundary after ages. A full toss, around off, Mostary gets down and slogs this between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket!
Works this through fine leg for a single.
A short ball, outside off, pulled uppishly towards deep mid-wicket. It does not carry to the fielder running in and she misfields. But the batters take just a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
WIDE. Full and down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Dropped short, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Outside off, played straight to point.

OUT! LBW! Dead duck. A length ball, pretty straight, Rumana gets across and looks to pull but misses and is hit on the pads. There is a loud shout for LBW, the umpire takes his time but then raises his finger. Rumana has a chat with her partner but then walks off.

Full and outside off, Rumana gets down and looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. There is a massive shout for LBW as the ball rolls to short third man. No interest shown by the umpire. Impact well outside off.
On middle and off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Works this through fine leg for a run.
Outside off, pushed through mid on for a single.

OUT! ANOTHER RUN OUT! Harakiri from Bangladesh. A length ball, around middle, Rumana works this towards mid-wicket and calls for a single. Ritu Moni responds but she is sold a dummy down the river. She has to turn back but by then, the throw comes in from Amelia Kerr to the bowler. Simple run out.
This is going from bad to worse for Bangladesh.
A loopy full toss, around off, swung straight to short mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, cut uppishly but straight to point. Lands just short.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
FOUR! Fine shot. A length ball, around middle, Ritu backs away and drags this over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.

Safe as a house. Full and around middle, Rumana works this through mid-wicket and calls her partner through for a quick single. The fielder responds as well, charging in quickly and scoring a direct hit at the keeper's end. It is referred upstairs but replays show that Moni was well in. 59 more needed from 58 balls.
Direct hit! Ritu Moni looks to be safe though. Referred upstairs. Safe as a house as per the replay.
A full toss, down the leg side, tickled towards fine leg for a single.
Full and around off, driven back to the bowler.
Rumana Ahmed walks in at number 6, replacing Fargana.

OUT! RUN OUT! Total mishap. No communication and that is the end of the short stay for Fargana. She is storming up, having a few words to say to her partner but that will have to be in the dressing room. New Zealand are bossing this now. Full and outside off, Hoque pushes this towards cover and sets off for a single. But there is no calling. Hence, the non-striker pays no heed. She then sees the striker charging towards her and has to send her back. Too late. Sohpie Devine charges onto the ball from short extra cover and returns a simple throw to the keeper Rachel Priest. Gone. 61 more needed from 61 balls.
Fractionally short outside off, cut straight to backward point.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.

NIGAR SULTANA IS WALKING OFF. This is a body blow to Bangladesh. She was getting into some sort of rhythm but now, it has been cut short, unluckily. The stretcher has been called for and the new batter, Fargana Hoque, is already walking out to the middle. The stretcher has not come out but it is more sort of a cabbie, like the ones we have in golf. Sultana struggles to get up and then limps, hobbles, loses balance but is given some support. Seems like she is struggling to breathe. Hope all is well with her...
Nigar Sultana is down in immense pain. This does not look good at all. The physio is coming running out to the middle.
OUCH! That must have hurt. Sultana is down in pain. Full and outside off, Sultana reaches out, looks to sweep but gets a top edge. The ball flies and hits her right on the neck!
Starts with one down the leg side, tickled past short fine leg. The fielder does well to get to the ball and slide to prevent the boundary. Two runs taken.
Anna Peterson to bowl now.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
A sharp bouncer, right at the face of the batter, Nigar ducks out of harm's way at the last moment.
Full and around off, well blocked out.
Around off, this is driven uppishly and nearly finds cover!
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Sophie Devine now has the ball.
Full toss outside off, pushed towards mid off.

Huge shout for LBW! Turned down! No review taken. Was that turning too much? The googly, around off, Ritu looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. There is a long discussion between the players but no review taken. Ball Tracker shows it to be missing leg.
Full and around off, Moni looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto her pads.
Goes right back in her crease and defends.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Landed outside off, Moni chops it down past short third man. Anna Peterson chases after it and then dives to flick it back to the fielder running behind her from short fine leg. Two runs taken.
Full and around middle, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Nigar walks down the track this time, but gets a length ball. Can only defend towards cover.
Short and outside off, NS pulls but finds short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, this is eased wide of Sophie Devine at short extra cover and a brace is added to the total.
Full and outside off, hint of width, Moni waits for it and then opens the face of her bat at the last moment to guide it towards third man. A single taken.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Full and around off, watchfully defended. 23/2 for Bangladesh in the Powerplay. New Zealand were 33/0 at this stage. 69 more needed from 84 balls.
FOUR! Off the top edge. Full and outside off, Sultana looks to sweep but gets a top edge. There is no one at short fine leg and the ball limps towards the fence.
Close call! The wrong 'un from Kerr, outside off, Sultana goes back to cut but gets a bottom edge which goes back to the bowler!
DROPPED! Tough chance. Short and outside off, Nigar looks to cut but is too close to the ball. Gets a bottom edge which hits the keeper's pads even before she can react. Goes down.
Landed outside off, punched straight to cover.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Nigar Sultana walks in at number 4, replacing Ayesha Rahman.

OUT! CAUGHT! Second wicket in the Powerplay and the pressure is telling on Bangladesh. This is exceptional bowling from New Zealand. They are tying the runs down and that is resulting in the wickets. Full and around off, Ayesha looks to go over the top but the ball hits her bat on the higher side. The ball lobs in the air and Sophie Devine runs back from mid off to complete a good catch. Bangladesh are getting into a mire. This can quickly turn into a whirlpool. 73 more needed from 90 balls.
Outside off, this is driven through the covers where a half stop keeps the batters to a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, punched straight to short extra cover.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended.
Hayley Jensen to bowl now.
Punches this off the back foot. Excellent follow-up over to the previous one.
Very full outside off, Ayesha looks to drive but is beaten by the length. The keeper collects, whips the bails off and appeals. But to no avail.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Flicks this through the leg side for a single.
Outside off, flatter and shorter, Moni looks to cut but gets a thick inside edge.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Amelia Kerr to bowl now.
Ritu Moni walks in at number 3, replacing Murshida Khatun.

OUT! CAUGHT! There goes the first wicket. Full and outside off, Murshida looks to slog this across the line, that too, to a ball spinning away. Gets a top edge which goes only as far as square leg. Simple catch for Anna Peterson. 75 more needed from 102 balls.
Full toss outside off, driven straight to mid off.

Full and outside off, Ayesha gets down and slog sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder comes running in for the catch, dives forward but the ball still lands short. Excellent stuff. Just a single.
WIDE. Down the leg side, left alone.
On middle and off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Fine shot. Full and around middle, Murshida comes down the track and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Full and outside off, spinning away, Murshida pushes but misses.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
WIDE. The radar is gone haywire. Another one down the leg side, flick shot missed once more.
WIDE. Third of the over. Full and down the leg side, flick shot missed.
A length ball, around middle, Khatun swivels and pulls it towards fine leg for a single.

EDGED, DROPPED! Gosh, that was a sitter. A length ball, outside off, Murshida looks to run it down to third man but finds Amelia Kerr at wide first slip. The ball goes straight to Kerr, right in the bread basket but then pops out.
Outside off, another play and a miss.
Outside off, on a length, Khatun looks to steer it to third man but misses.
WIDE AGAIN. A length ball, wide outside off, Khatun slashes hard but misses.
WIDE. Down the leg side, left alone.
Lea Tahuhu to bowl from the other end.
Full toss and around middle, well blocked out. Watchful start by Bangladesh.
Full and outside off, driven wide of mid off for a single.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
FOUR! Just wide of the fielder! Great attempt. Full on middle, Murshida lofts it over the bowler. Mid on flies to her right, tries to catch but the ball escapes her.
Landed outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The players are out in the middle. Murshida Khatun and Ayesha Rahman are the openers for Bangladesh. Leigh Kasperek to start off proceedings. Murshida to face. Here we go!
